title: [Bug]: test_config_reload_with_rendered_golden_config.py PORTCHANNEL is undefined
author: dayouliu1
body:
### Issue Description

golden_config_infra/test_config_reload_with_rendered_golden_config.py will throw `jinja2.exceptions.UndefinedError: 'PORTCHANNEL' is undefined` 

when running `sonic-cfggen -d -t /tmp/golden_config_db.j2 > /etc/sonic/golden_config_db.json`

### Results you see

golden_config_infra/test_config_reload_with_rendered_golden_config.py fails when running `sonic-cfggen -d -t /tmp/golden_config_db.j2 > /etc/sonic/golden_config_db.json`

### Results you expected to see

No failure

### Is it platform specific

generic

### Relevant log output

```shell
complex_args = {}
filename   = '/data/tests/common/devices/multi_asic.py'
function_name = '_run_on_asics'
index      = 0

module_args = ['sonic-cfggen -d -t /tmp/golden_config_db.j2 > /etc/sonic/golden_config_db.json']
module_async = False
module_ignore_errors = False

```
